title: Built a Jean Phil AI (jeanphilai.cc): 1 selfie → blond bowl cut + curled moustache deadpan short (Oui Madame.)
excerpt: 分享创造 - @boisy - Sharing a small product I shipped this week — looking for technical and positioning feedback.Con
content_html:
Sharing a small product I shipped this week — looking for technical and positioning feedback.

Context: where “Jean Phil” comes from In Sept 2026 a character known as Jean Philanthrope / Jean Phil went viral on TikTok and Instagram: honey-blond bowl cut, curled moustache, pink houndstooth suit (or yellow polo), deadpan face, shadowboxing / selfie micro-choreography, captions ending in “Oui Madame.” Clips are short, vertical, and meme-copyable — people recreate the look and moves rather than quoting a commercial music video. The trend is fan/meme culture; this tool is independent of the original creator and any related commercial or token projects.

What I built Jean Phil AI — jeanphilai.cc

Independent fan utility: one clear front-facing adult photo → locked-motion template short (~12–15s, 9:16) with the bowl cut + moustache + deadpan beats, plus model-generated ambient audio (no ripped commercial tracks). Scene gallery includes night selfie, café, street, and more.

Stack notes for this crowd: Cloudflare Worker + D1; generation via KIE (primary) with TryAll Seedance fallback.

Pricing (one-time packs, no sub): Single $8.88 · 3-pack $16.99 · Creator $39.90.

Limits / compliance Independent fan tool — not affiliated with the original creator or any token 18+; no celebs / MV stills / non-consensual faces / NSFW “Upload my clip → Jean Phil cast” is still WIP Ask Landing clarity for non-fans? Pack pricing? Which scene templates matter most?

Happy to take hard notes. Thanks.
